customer_reply:
Hi,

Thanks for reaching out. The "QUOTA_EXCEEDED: storage limit reached" message means your AnalyticsHub storage allocation for the current plan has been exhausted. To restore access to the Dashboard you can either:
1. Delete or archive unused data to free up space, or
2. Increase your storage quota by upgrading your plan or purchasing additional storage.

Please refer to our Storage Limits guide (https://kb.company.com/products/analyticshub#pricing--limits-by-plan) for the exact limits per plan and the steps to request more capacity. Let us know which option you’d like to pursue, and we’ll be happy to help with the cleanup or the upgrade process.

Best regards,
Support Team
